versions.name: Camp Tres Ritos

features.note: Units cook breakfast and supper in their own campsites from food issued by camp.
Trail to First Class, combined with two Eagle-required badges.
A guided five-day trek in the Sangre de Cristo Mountains.
Fly fishing on national forest water; a state licence is required.
Merit badge classes are taught in or near covered shelters.

versions.summary: High-altitude Scouts BSA resident summer camp in New Mexico's Sangre de Cristo Mountains, operated by the South Plains Council, featuring patrol-style cooking and a merit-badge program, with units bringing their own tents and cooking gear.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
